children: Columbus Acquisition adjourned its Extraordinary General Meeting without conducting business and will set a reconvened date and extended redemption deadline.
The Meeting was convened on Sept. 10, 2026, but the chairman adjourned it without submitting proposals to a vote.
The adjournment applies to all proposals, including the proposed business combination with WISeSat.Space.
The company will announce the reconvened meeting date and an Extended Redemption Deadline in the coming days.
Public shareholders must complete redemption procedures by the Extended Redemption Deadline; as of Sept. 8, 2026 trust held ~$10.66 per share.
The record date for voting remains close of business Aug. 17, 2026; shareholders as of that date remain eligible to vote.
